en.settings_filter_muted_users_desc: One username, display name, or user ID per line. @ is optional for usernames.
en.settings_read_aloud_entry_desc: When on, detail, bookmarks, lists, and profile pages show the floating read-aloud button. Turning it off hides the entry without stopping current playback.
en.reply_publish_failed: Unable to publish to X. Your content remains in the editor.
en.post_continue_in_x_with_media: X's composer is open. Add the media again and confirm the post in X.
en.post_open_web_failed: Unable to open a browser for this post. Try again.
en.post_send_unconfirmed: Publication is not confirmed. Your content remains in the editor. Check your X profile before retrying to avoid duplicate posts.
en.post_upload_needs_session: Attachments require an X web session. Sign in through the X login page before sending.
en.profile_likes_unavailable: Couldn't load liked posts. Pull down to retry.
en.community_home_empty_desc: This timeline shows posts from Communities you’ve joined.
en.community_join_rules_intro: Review and agree to these Community rules. They apply in addition to the X Rules.
en.community_rules_load_failed: Could not load the Community rules. Refresh and try again.
en.community_leave_confirm: You will need to join again to restore member access.
en.community_join_request_sent: Join request sent. A moderator must approve it.
en.community_post_visibility: Community posts are public on X and may appear in search, on profiles, and in other timelines.
en.community_post_session_required: Community posts need an active X web session. Sign in to your X account first.
en.community_post_fallback_unsupported: X rejected the community post request. It was not sent as a regular post, and your draft is still saved.
en.settings_lists_desc: Open the timelines of lists you own or follow.
en.settings_link_in_app_desc: When on, links in posts load in a half-screen sheet instead of the system browser.
en.settings_video_autoplay_desc: When on, videos play automatically as they enter the screen. Turn it off to play from the cover.
en.settings_home_video_mute_desc: Home and the video feed share one sound setting. Mute or unmute any post to apply and remember that choice for following posts.
en.settings_video_auto_pip_desc: On a post's detail page, a playing video moves into a floating picture-in-picture window when you scroll it off screen, so you can keep watching while you read the replies. Turn it off to simply pause the video.
en.settings_video_immersive_fill_desc: Use a black background when on, or a soft video backdrop when off. The full frame keeps its original proportions, with playback controls in a fixed footer.
en.video_feed_controls_always_visible_desc: Keep post information and playback controls visible during playback. Tap the video to hide or restore them together.
en.settings_video_control_style_desc: Choose bottom fade controls or the original floating controls.
en.settings_video_control_style_original_de: Rounded floating control bar with the original button layout.
en.settings_video_control_style_spaced_desc: Full-width progress and spaced playback controls at the screen bottom; hidden during playback.
en.settings_sensitive_media: Show media that may contain sensitive content
en.settings_sensitive_media_desc: Sync your X account’s sensitive media preference and apply it in Harmony X.
en.sensitive_media_hidden: Media that may contain sensitive content is hidden
en.settings_video_background_intro: What a fullscreen video does when you leave the app or lock the screen.
en.settings_video_background_audio_desc: The picture stays where it is and the sound keeps running, with play, pause and seeking handled from the system media panel.
en.settings_video_background_pip_desc: Leaving the app hands the video to a picture-in-picture window so it keeps playing while you use other apps.
en.settings_media_desc: Choose the quality used for loading, playback, and downloads.
en.settings_media_intro: Photos default to original size, while video quality is selected automatically. Higher quality looks sharper but uses more data. Downloads use the same selection.
en.settings_image_quality_data_saver_desc: Load smaller photos to reduce mobile data use.
en.settings_image_quality_high_desc: Balance sharpness and loading speed for everyday use.
en.settings_image_quality_original_desc: Default option. Load and download photos at their original size.
en.settings_video_quality_smooth_desc: Prefer the lowest bitrate at or above 500kbps for faster, lighter playback.
en.settings_video_quality_high_desc: Default option. Prefer the highest available bitrate.
en.settings_video_quality_auto_desc: Start with a moderate rendition and try lower bitrates first if playback stalls.
en.settings_video_quality_sd_desc: Choose an available standard definition rendition for a balance of clarity and speed.
en.settings_video_quality_ld_desc: Choose the lowest bitrate rendition for slower connections.
en.photo_ocr_unavailable: Text recognition is not supported on this device
en.photo_subject_unavailable: Subject cutout is not supported on this device
en.gif_save_started: Downloading GIF. Choose Save to Gallery when ready.
en.media_download_started: Downloading. Choose Save to Gallery when ready.
en.media_download_all_started: Downloading all originals. Choose Save to Gallery when ready.
en.download_manager_desc: Track, pause, resume, or delete downloads and clear video cache.
en.download_background_note: When the app goes to the background, the system keeps downloads running as a data transfer task and shows their progress.
en.download_background_limit: The system may still stop a transfer if you force stop the app or power off the device. Incomplete tasks are kept so you can resume them later.
en.download_cache_desc: Remove temporary video files saved for playback. Photos and videos already saved to Gallery stay untouched.
en.diagnostics_desc: Recent interface calls and the private-API self check.
en.block_confirm: They won't be able to follow you or see your posts. Block this account?
en.post_translate_failed: Translation failed. Check the network or API configuration.
en.post_translate_no_key: Enable web translation or set up a provider and API key in Settings > Translation first
en.settings_translation_desc: Translate posts with web auto translation or your own API key
en.settings_translation_intro: Translate with your signed-in X account, Google web translation, or your chosen model provider. API keys stay on this device; avoid entering them on a shared device.
en.settings_translation_web_note: No API key is required. Post text is sent directly to Google Translate's web service; availability can change with the network, rate limits, or website rules.
en.settings_translation_api_key_note: Stored in local preferences. It is never sent to X or to this project's servers.
en.settings_translation_auto_enable_desc: Automatically use the selected method (enable translation first)
en.settings_translation_base_url_note: Required for Azure OpenAI and self-hosted gateways, for example https://your-resource.openai.azure.com/openai/v1
en.settings_gateway_intro: The gateway is a self-hosted harmonyx-gateway service. It holds the X cookie session, the GraphQL query ids and the anti-bot headers, while the app stores only an access token. Interface changes need a server update, not a new build.
en.settings_gateway_token_note: Must match the server's GATEWAY_TOKEN. A server without a token only accepts loopback clients, so a phone always needs one.
en.settings_gateway_session_intro: Sign in to x.com in a browser, then copy auth_token and ct0 from the developer tools cookies and paste them as auth_token=…; ct0=…. The value is sent to the gateway only and is not stored on the phone.
en.settings_private_desc: Manage the cookie session used by the private API
en.settings_private_intro: The private surface (GraphQL / REST 1.1) identifies the account by cookie: auth_token is who you are, ct0 is sent as x-csrf-token. This is captured automatically during sign-in; paste it here if the web engine withholds it.
en.settings_private_placeholder: Sign in to x.com in a browser, copy auth_token and ct0 from the developer tools, then paste them as:
en.settings_private_incomplete: Cookie is incomplete: both auth_token and ct0 are required
en.private_session_expired: The private interface session expired. Sign in again or paste the cookie in Settings > Private interface session.
en.status_dm_unsupported: Direct messages use the XChat encryption protocol and are not supported yet; everything else works.
en.login_x_account_desc: Sign in to x.com inside the app. No developer application required — timelines, posting, replies, search, notifications and profiles all work.
en.login_developer_api_desc: Requires your own X developer app Client ID configured in Settings.
en.auth_session_waiting: Sign in to X below; the app returns automatically once you are in
en.accounts_intro: Add X accounts here and switch between them. Each account keeps its own credentials on this device, so switching never asks you to sign in again.
en.accounts_manage_desc: Add several X accounts and switch the one in use at any time.
en.accounts_add_desc: Sign in with another X account. Accounts already stored stay signed in.
en.accounts_remove_confirm: Removing this account signs it out for good; the other accounts are untouched. Remove it?
en.accounts_note: Cookie sessions and access tokens live in the app's private storage and are never uploaded anywhere else. Removing an account deletes its credentials too.
en.accounts_add_waiting: x.com is still signed in to an account you already added. Sign out of it, or sign in with another X account.
en.read_aloud_playing: Playing — it keeps going after you leave this page
en.dm_no_messages: This conversation has no displayable messages
en.dm_encrypted_message: This message uses XChat encryption and cannot be decrypted in this version yet
en.dm_rate_limited: X is temporarily limiting message requests. Please try again later.
en.dm_send_unsupported: This conversation uses XChat encryption; plain-text sending is not available yet
en.dm_legacy_only: This row comes from the official DM event stream and has no conversation ID to open
en.dm_xchat_readonly: XChat conversation: this version can read the thread and message count; sending and decryption need the key exchange
en.dm_web_failed: Could not load messages. Check the network or proxy and try again
en.permission_microphone_reason: Records voice input in Grok web mode and voice messages
en.proxy_auto_switch_desc: Switch to the next saved proxy when a request fails
en.proxy_video_cdn_desc: Match video.twimg.com and its subdomains. When enabled, MP4 requests always use the selected in-app proxy, regardless of system VPN detection. Retry playback after enabling. HLS uses the system network.
en.proxy_scope_note: The proxy applies to in-app HTTP requests. Follow-through for WebView and system download components depends on the OS version.
en.proxy_socks5_unsupported: SOCKS5 requires HarmonyOS 7 / API 26 or later
en.mid_autumn_blessing: The moon is full and the osmanthus is in bloom. We wish you a happy Mid-Autumn Festival, a joyful family reunion and everything you are hoping for.
en.post_interactions_no_quotes_detail: Quotes with someone's thoughts will appear here.
en.settings_grok_intro: Choose how Grok opens from a post. Web mode uses the official Grok website; API mode uses your own xAI API configuration.
en.settings_grok_mode_web_note: Open grok.com in the app and try to bring the current post's text and link into the Grok webpage. Sign-in and usage are managed by the official website.
en.settings_grok_mode_api_note: Send the current post to the xAI API as context and show the genuine reply in the app.
en.settings_grok_x_session_desc: Write the current account's X web session into ArkWeb before opening Grok. Selecting Sign in with X in Grok can then continue the official flow; no X credential is sent to grok.com.
en.settings_grok_api_key_note: Stored only on this device and used only for api.x.ai. Web mode does not require an API key.
en.grok_context_hint: This post will be sent to Grok as context when you ask a question.
en.grok_not_configured: In Settings > Translation & AI, select Grok, enable API mode, and enter an xAI API key.
en.grok_web_mode_hint: Opening grok.com with the current post as a webpage request parameter. If this Grok web version does not prefill it, paste the post link into Grok's composer.
en.grok_web_prompt_prefix: Analyze this X post, using its text and link as context:
en.onboarding_welcome_detail: Read your timeline, discover new conversations, and stay close to the people you follow.
en.onboarding_explore_detail: Browse For you and Following, and search posts, people, and trending topics.
en.onboarding_connect_detail: Sign in to post, reply, like, and see your notifications and profile.
en.onboarding_login_hint: Sign in on the web page below. Harmony X will open automatically when you finish.
en.onboarding_login_save_failed: Signed in, but the account could not be saved. Try again or use account management later.
en.onboarding_timeline_detail: Switch between two ways to read your Home feed.
en.onboarding_for_you_detail: Discover posts through topics and interactions.
en.onboarding_following_detail: Read posts from accounts you follow in time order.
en.onboarding_refresh_detail: Pull to refresh. Cached content remains available offline.
en.onboarding_search_detail: Search keywords and narrow results with filters.
en.onboarding_people_detail: Open profiles to see posts and follow relationships.
en.onboarding_topics_detail: Browse trends, news, and recommendations in Explore.
en.onboarding_post_detail: Write posts, add photos or videos, and join replies.
en.onboarding_react_detail: Like, repost, and bookmark posts you want to keep.
en.onboarding_profile_detail: See your posts, likes, and profile information.
en.onboarding_media_detail: These switches save immediately and can be changed later in Settings.
en.onboarding_notifications_detail: Notifications, unread alerts, and messages are in the bottom navigation.
en.onboarding_messages_detail: Message availability depends on your X account and the current interface.
en.onboarding_permission_detail: To receive system notifications, sign in, then enable and authorize them in Settings.
en.onboarding_tips_detail: A few choices to make Harmony X feel right for you.
en.onboarding_customize_detail: Change appearance, language, text size, and Home layout in Settings.
en.onboarding_account_detail: If you skip web sign-in, you can still add or switch accounts from account management.
en.onboarding_already_signed_in: Your X account is connected. You can start using Harmony X now.
